- **`__init__(capacity)`** — Validates positive capacity, initializes hash map and sentinel head/tail nodes
- **`get(key)`** — Returns value or `-1`; moves accessed node to front (most recently used)
- **`put(key, value)`** — Updates existing key (moves to front) or inserts new key (evicts LRU if at capacity)
